title: Type safety
summary: No casts, no non-null assertions, no any, no unsafe Rust.

requirements.text: TypeScript in `src/`, `tests/` and `scripts/` has no type assertions other than `as const`, and no non-null `!`.
TypeScript has no explicit `any`, and in `src/` no value of type `any` flows anywhere.

history.text: TypeScript has no `any`, and in `src/` no value of type `any` flows anywhere.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: tests and scripts are not typechecked, so only an explicit `any` is caught there.

requirements.text: Lint rules cannot be disabled by an `eslint-disable` comment, except `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`.

history.text: Lint rules cannot be disabled by a comment, except `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`.

requirements.text: Every Rust crate under `src-tauri` forbids unsafe code, except the app crate, which denies it with one exception: the Android JNI entry point for background sync.
